title: What you paste into the chatbot
brief: 17:25. Dan needs a supplier spend breakdown by seven. A free public chatbot could do it in seconds, if you paste the data in.
insight: What you paste into a public AI tool leaves the company. It can be stored, read by reviewers, and used to train the next model.
teaches: A public chatbot is an outside company: pasting data into it is sharing it
Free plans usually keep, review and train on what you paste
Use the approved tool for company data, and never paste personal, financial or secret data into anything else

/.muted: Free AI assistant. Paste anything, ask anything.
